bounded_contexts.name: cloud-iac
bounded_contexts.description: Code-backed Cloud IaC local foundation for metadata-only OpenTofu module release records, in-memory module registry invariants, cell topology planning metadata, GitOps reconciliation evidence, and the existing IaC tier-discipline gate. No live OpenTofu registry API, REST/SDK/worker runtime, provider plan/apply, Argo CD API integration, measured SLO, active-active DR, sharding automation, or audit-chain persistence is claimed by CS-CLOUD-IAC-001.

audit_chain.non_claim: CS-CLOUD-IAC-001 creates metadata evidence refs and an evidence bundle but does not implement audit-chain persistence or sealing.

secrets_substrate.format: SecretReference metadata only through Cloud Secrets; Cloud IaC does not store raw provider credentials, kubeconfigs, tokens, state files, or secret material.

mesh_layering.non_claim: CS-CLOUD-IAC-001 records cell topology metadata and forbids default cross-cell traffic in domain validation, but does not implement or measure live mesh policy enforcement.

naming_justifications: Cloud IaC now claims only the implemented oya-cloud-iac-domain foundation crate and the existing oya-check-iac-tier-discipline crate. The previous oya-cloud-iac-iac-* crate roster was removed from this manifest because none of those crates exists in the workspace.

module_library_scope.canonical_adr_0339_path_not_claimed: ADR-0339's microservices/cloud-iac/modules/<context>/<primitive>/ library has not been materialized in this ChangeSet; current evidence is limited to the pre-existing microservices/cloud-iac/tofu/modules skeleton catalog plus the domain registry invariants.
non_claims: no live private module registry API
no signed or cosign-attested module release index
no OpenTofu providers mirror or dependency lock evidence

enforced_invariants: manifest catalog path, source root, module count, module names, and modeled fields must match the catalog
catalog id and source path root are non-empty repo-relative paths
every module source_path must stay under the declared source_path_root
every module main_file must be exactly <source_path>/main.tofu
every module main_file must exist in the local workspace
local-foundation-skeleton entries cannot claim provider resources, outputs, or tests
coherence_guard.runtime_non_claim: First-class Oya local filesystem/JSON gate only; no live registry API, OpenTofu CLI execution, provider lockfile, module signing, provider credentials, tofu init/validate/plan/apply, or Argo CD API integration is implemented by this ChangeSet.

capacity_model.notes: CS-CLOUD-IAC-001 is a pure domain/metadata foundation. Runtime OpenTofu execution, module registry service, Argo CD API integration, measured capacity, autoscaling, and SLOs remain explicit non-claims.

sharding_automation.non_claim: CS-CLOUD-IAC-001 records cell topology metadata only; it does not implement autosharding, auto-rebalance, dynamic-sharding execution, tenant migration, or audit-chain persistence.

dr.non_claim: No Cloud IaC runtime persistence store, restore drill, active-active replication, or failover evidence is implemented by CS-CLOUD-IAC-001.

pod_runtime_tier_justification: Cloud IaC controls deployment/cell topology metadata for future high-criticality infrastructure. Runtime pods are not implemented yet; Tier-1 is retained only as intended future isolation class.
foundation_non_claims: no oya-cloud-iac-iac-* crates exist or are claimed
no REST, SDK, worker, provider adapter, OpenTofu CLI runner, Argo CD API adapter, Postgres registry adapter, rollback engine, or drift detector runtime is implemented
no measured SLO, burn-rate, active-active DR, sharding execution, live mesh enforcement, provider lockfile, tofu plan/apply, or capacity telemetry evidence exists for Cloud IaC runtime
legacy microservices/cloud-iac/*.md IP files and capability YAMLs may remain historical planning/prose but are not used as implementation-ready evidence by this manifest

CS-CLOUD-IAC-MODULE-CATALOG-GATE-001 adds a first-class local filesystem/JSON Oya gate for manifest/catalog/main.tofu coherence but does not implement a private module registry, module signing, provider lockfiles, provider-resource-complete modules, or tofu init/validate/plan/apply runtime.
